_comment: Optional engines Flick can download on demand into ~/Library/Application Support/Flick/engines/<id>/. Every entry is pinned by URL + SHA-256 + size; the downloader refuses anything that doesn't match. Built-in macOS tools (sips, afconvert, avconvert, textutil, cupsfilter, PDFKit, zip/tar) need no download. ImageMagick, Ghostscript, poppler and mupdf have no official macOS binaries and stay Homebrew-only extras.

engines.name: FFmpeg 9.0.2 (static)
engines.unlocks: every video and audio format, MP3/Opus encoding, WebP/AVIF/GIF/APNG images, subtitles
engines.license: GPL-3.0 (static build with x264/x265); invoked as a separate process

engines.name: FFprobe 9.0.2 (static)
engines.unlocks: media inspection (duration, streams) for smarter wheels

engines.name: Pandoc 3.12.1
engines.unlocks: Markdown, HTML, EPUB, DOCX, RTF, reStructuredText, LaTeX and other markup conversions

engines.name: qpdf 12.4.2
engines.unlocks: PDF split, merge, page ranges, linearize, decrypt

engines.name: 7-Zip 23.01 (console)
engines.unlocks: 7z, RAR, ISO, CAB and other archives; create 7z

engines.name: LibreOffice 26.8.1
engines.unlocks: XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODS/ODP and legacy Office formats → PDF and each other
